name: Exhibition Gallery
description: A landscape exhibition with spacious image frames, glass captions, category transitions and a full-screen crossfade viewer.

settings.label: Image captions
default: A break in the cloud · Italian Dolomites
Under the canopy · Canada · Pacific coast
Stone and silence · United States · Southwest

settings.label: Display tags
settings.description: One displayed tag per image. Filter memberships can be separate.

settings.label: Filter memberships
settings.description: One comma-separated list per image. A photo may appear under several filters, but only once in the viewer.

settings.label: Custom image URLs
settings.description: Empty uses the twelve included worldwide landscape images. Supply matching captions and categories for custom images.
